title: Capcom's Platinum Titles: the five biggest by units, Monster Hunter: World first (Capcom IR, as of June 30, 2026)
game: Monster Hunter: World, Resident Evil 2, Monster Hunter Rise, Resident Evil 7 biohazard, Monster Hunter World: Iceborne
why: Evergreen bank piece (numbers). DATES IT: Capcom's IR Platinum Titles page, updated with each quarterly results (next: Q3 FY3/2027, early Feb 2027; the page was 'as of June 30, 2026' when read, the H1 report of 30 Sep 2026 may update it).

sources.name: Capcom IR, Product Data, Platinum Titles (as of June 30, 2026), read in full 8 Nov 2026

first_report: Capcom IR Platinum Titles page, as of June 30, 2026 (the page's own date), read 8 Nov 2026 about 12:10Z with a browser user agent (the plain fetch tool gets 403). Evergreen.
footage: Our graphics (numbers): Capcom's own Steam library art for the five titles, ending on two official Monster Hunter: World Steam screenshots (1920x1080). No single footage covers five games; sources tried: capcom.co.jp IR page images (Japanese package strips, not used), Steam store assets.

claims.text: 1 Monster Hunter: World 22.40 million units (page note: '*Unit sales including Monster Hunter World: Iceborne Master Edition: 30.40 million units'; footnote '* Excludes shipments of Monster Hunter World: Iceborne Master Edition')
2 Resident Evil 2 19.70; 3 Monster Hunter Rise 19.30; 4 Resident Evil 7 biohazard 18.40; 5 Monster Hunter World: Iceborne 16.70 (million units); 6 Resident Evil 4 16.00

Page wording: 'Units', and 'DL (Full-game download) includes all digital download units for each platform'; the page does not call the figures sell-in or sell-through (its footnote uses 'shipments' for the Iceborne Master Edition exclusion), so the Reel says units (وحدات) and never sold to players
Three of the five are Monster Hunter titles and two are Resident Evil (our count from the list)
Outlet and search-snippet figures are not used
